records.title: Implementation Status of National AYUSH Mission.
details: (d) Resource pool for the year 2025-26 had been allocated on 24.02.2025 to all States/UTs as per Budget Estimate under NAM with request to submit the State Annual Action Plans (SAAPs) by 15th March, 2025 and regular follow up was made with them. As on date, 24 States/UTs have submitted their SAAPs, out of which 12 have been finalized. Ministry of Ayush is coordinating with the States/UTs who have not submitted their SAAPs.
